name: Moderna, Inc.
summary:
Moderna (MRNA) reported earnings of $0.38 per share on revenue of $1.31 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $1.10 per share on revenue of $888.78 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 134.55% while revenue grew 29.23% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects 2026 revenue of $2.236 billion to $2.430 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of approximately $2.138 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $2.100 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Moderna has transformed from a research-stage company advancing programs in the field of messenger RNA (mRNA), to an enterprise with a diverse clinical portfolio of vaccines and therapeutics across seven modalities, a broad intellectual property portfolio in areas including mRNA and lipid nanoparticle formulation, and an integrated manufacturing plant that allows for both clinical and commercial production at scale.
subject: Moderna Beat Consensus Estimates, Raises Guidance
